description: Using blocks: a door opened, walked through and closed from the other side, an iron door that doesn't open by hand (stone in hand goes against it); a trapdoor in the floor opened under the player; a fence gate opened, walked through, closed and opened again from the other side (it turns); a lever twice, a button, a repeater's delay three times, a comparator, a note block, a daylight detector; a cake eaten when hungry; a candle on a cake; a dandelion potted; sweet berries picked; seeds in a composter; a sneaking click on the door with stone places it.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.1 with minecraft:candle 4
item replace entity @a hotbar.2 with minecraft:dandelion 4
item replace entity @a hotbar.3 with minecraft:wheat_seeds 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.4 with minecraft:stone 16
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
